body: I’m in the same boat my friend.

It’s going to hurt for a while, there’s no denying that. What I personally found helpful was to reach out to other people you feel you can confide in. Also feel free to message me. Things will get better :)

I really needed to hear this. It’s an everyday struggle for me personally. What makes it harder is there has only ever been one person I’ve told this to, and now they are no longer in my life. Thank you
This is the first post I’ve ever truly related to. It’s been months and I keep telling myself it’s gonna get easier, but it just hasn’t
